e: Rebracketing of emancipation, replacing man with woman.
q: In the ecstasy of ewomancipation she drank half a bottle of cologne and smoked two whole Chinese punk sticks. She was free, free!
"Still believe in ewomancipation now, Miss Klein?"
1958, Van Lane Ferguson, We Bark at Midnight:
I am warning all men, please take this seriously "emancipation is one thing, ewomancipation is another".
